title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 48
paragraphs: So in this way Dorieus ended his life. But if he had endured to be a subject of Cleomenes and had stayed in Sparta, he would have been king of Lacedaemon; for Cleomenes reigned no very long time, and died leaving no son to succeed him but only a daughter, whose name was Gorgo.
